One browser session per independent run; one new tab per posting. Fill sequentially, verify persisted field values and resume attachment, save evidence and awaiting_manual_submit, then prepare the next tab.

Record preparation errors separately and keep useful failed/blocked tabs for manual correction; never label an incomplete form ready.

Keep the process/browser alive after preparation to monitor all handed-off tabs without stealing focus. Record confirmed applied or portal duplicate; known form rejection returns awaiting_correction; unconfirmed possible activation remains uncertain.

Keep explicit unknown/never modes: unknown hands off jobs with unknown answers and auto-submits others; never uses the explicit automated path. New-tab navigation applies consistently.
Respect limits/cap while counting outstanding manual handoffs, so opening many uncounted tabs cannot bypass the configured run cap.
